page_note: This page contains an extended FARMER PARABLE applied to the mission of apostles coming to the world, culminating in references to the elect, the catechumens, and the "new church." None of it is cosmological-correspondential substrate. The parable is a didactic-applicative simile: farmer→apostle, seed→humanity, harvest→eschaton. The mapping reaches outward to the editorial-pastoral world (apostolic mission, ecclesial categories, new church), not inward to cosmic structure. Heavy damage (100%) means many segments are too fragmentary to firmly classify, but the visible substance is uniformly application/ecclesial. Two seam-relevant segments: i=13 explicit elect+catechumens institutional language, i=23 "new church" institutional language. The farmer simile itself, even where cosmologically suggestive, belongs to the apostolic-pastoral parable register, not the substrate.
